hero_section.description: Above-fold placement for major credentials only
hero_section.best_for: Years in business (10+), unique differentiators, flagship awards

dedicated_awards_page.description: Full page or section with detailed information
dedicated_awards_page.best_for: Comprehensive award lists, press coverage, timeline displays

official_badge_images.description: Using official award graphics from granting organization
official_badge_images.pros: Instant recognition, professional appearance, legitimacy signal
official_badge_images.cons: Dependent on award terms of use, visual clutter if too many

custom_showcase_design.description: Custom-designed awards section matching site aesthetic
custom_showcase_design.pros: Flexible layout, can include descriptions, on-brand appearance
custom_showcase_design.cons: Requires design resources, may lack instant recognition

text_integration.pros: Natural flow, no separate section needed, SEO benefit
text_integration.cons: Easy to miss, less visual impact

timeline_history_format.description: Chronological display of awards/recognition over time
timeline_history_format.pros: Shows progression, demonstrates consistency, impressive longevity display
